title: Cumulative Volume Delta CVD API: real-time taker buy vs sell volume divergence f
description: Cumulative Volume Delta CVD API: real-time taker buy vs sell volume divergence for Bitcoin BTC and Ethereum ETH. Detects bullish accumulation (price down + CVD up) and bearish exhaustion (price up + CVD down). 1h and 4h divergence signals from Hyperliquid DEX trade flow.
